failures.detail: 下語 s1 o1: (古尊宿語錄); the assembly is ordered to lay down words on the '(兜率陀天底)' ('the one in Tusita Heaven') presentation, and when they fizzle the master lays down his own capping word (末後下語云) — '(慈氏菩薩)' (Maitreya). Shows both assembly-(下語) and the master's own.

下語 s1 o2: (古尊宿語錄), in the episode of Nanquan shutting his quarters' door and ringing it with ash (南泉掩方丈門／灰圍) in the Recorded Sayings of Zhaozhou (趙州諗禪師語錄): Nanquan shuts the door, rings it with ash, and challenges 'say it and I open the door' (南泉便掩却方丈門便把灰圍却問僧云道得即開門…); Zhaozhou cries (蒼天蒼天) ('blue heavens! blue heavens!') and Nanquan opens the door. Many people lay down words, none accord with Nanquan's meaning (不契泉意) — the stock (下語)/(不契) ('lay down a word' / 'does not accord') dynamic.
下語 s1 o3: (普濟玉琳國師語錄); the master orders the assembly to lay down words, and when the laying-down is finished (下語畢) raises the case again — a bare description of the routine.
下語 s1 o4: (傳燈玉英集) (lamp-record digest); a senior monk lays down words through ninety-six turns without satisfying the master (不愜師意) — the testing/failing use.
下語 s1 o4 expected '傳燈玉英集（殘卷）': (傳燈玉英集) (lamp-record digest); a senior monk lays down words through ninety-six turns without satisfying the master (不愜師意) — the testing/failing use.
下語 s1 o5: (普濟玉琳國師語錄); that day monks and laity laid down quite a few words, so the master again capped in their stead (自代云) — the master's substitute (下語).
下語 s1 o6: Dahui raises Dongshan's saying and reports that successive offered responses failed to accord, preserving the public testing function.
下語 s1 o6 expected '大慧普覺禪師語錄': Dahui raises Dongshan's saying and reports that successive offered responses failed to accord, preserving the public testing function.
下語 s1 o7: In the bamboo-slat case the assembly's responses all fail to accord, after which a monk asks for instruction.
下語 s1 o7 expected '大慧普覺禪師語錄': In the bamboo-slat case the assembly's responses all fail to accord, after which a monk asks for instruction.
